sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

Heard Shri Dhirendra Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Standing Counsel for respondent Nos.1, 2 and 3.
2.

This writ petition has been filed seeking direction to the Presiding Officer, Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Varanasi (respondent No.2) to ensure hearing of the Reference Case No.03 of 2020 (Santosh Kumar Singh and others vs. Jagdish Singh and others)
under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Harshita And Another vs State Of Up And 15 Others on 11 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168378024/
1 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') and decide the same within stipulated period of time.

entities.text: Santosh Kumar Singh and others vs. Jagdish Singh and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Varanasi by order dated 14.09.2020 had made a reference under Section 76 of the Act, which was registered on 01.11.2020 and more than three years have passed since the date of registration of reference case but the proceedings have not been concluded.

4. The Court has perused the order sheet of the reference case and it finds that documents were filed by the parties and the matter was also heard on some dates but on account of adjournment by some of the parties, the reference case could not be decided.
5. Learned Standing Counsel submits that the court concerned shall decide the reference expeditiously, subject to co-operation by the respective parties.

6. In view of the above, considering more than three years pendency of the reference case in question, the writ petition stands disposed of directing the respondent No.2-Presiding Officer, Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Varanasi to conclude the proceedings of the Reference Case No.03 of 2020 (Santosh Kumar Singh and others vs. Jagdish Singh and others)
expeditiously, strictly in accordance with law, subject to cooperation by the parties.
Order Date :- 11.3.2024 Jyotsana  Harshita And Another vs State Of Up And 15 Others on 11 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168378024/
